name: wextend
expr: ys = wextend(1, 'sym', x, 2); yp = wextend(1, 'per', x, 2); yz = wextend(1, 'zpd', x, 2); yd = wextend(1, 'ppd', x, 2);
comment: Sig: y = wextend(1, mode, x, lf[, side]). Modes: sym (whole-point symm with edge), per (periodic with edge-pad on odd N), zpd (zero pad), ppd (true periodic). For odd-N periodic MATLAB pre-pads x with x(end) to even length, then wraps.
